NARRATIVE AND PLANS FOR PROPOSED REZONING FOR A TYPE 1 ZONING
AMENDMENT — 5417 W. ADAMS STREET

The current zoning of the parcel is RS-3 Residential Single-Unit (Detached

House) District. The zoning amendment is required to change the zoning of the parcel
to RT-4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District. The zoning change is

needed to permit a conversion of the basement to a residential use.

Lot Area: 3,100 sq. ft.
FAR: 0.9
Building Area: MAIN FLOOR 1,456 sq. ft.
Density/Dwelling Unit: 1,000 sq. ft.
Off Street Parking Spaces 2 spaces
Front Setback: 17-1”
Rear Setback: 40° - 6”
Sideyard: 0’ -0”
Sideyard: 0’ - 0”
Rear Yard Open Space: o

Building Height: 26’ — 5”

After rezoning, the property shall be used for (describe) Residential use of the
basement.
